title: The Unnumbered Reliquary Warden of the Last Ember Vault

portrait.user_prompt: an ancient armored warden guarding a vault of embers

lineage.instruction: an ancient armored warden guarding a vault of embers
make the armor darker and add more embers drifting upward

flavor.text: It has stood at the vault door since before the vault had a name, counting embers that never stop falling, and it will still be counting long after whoever reads this is gone.
